title: The Defector Bounty
logline: A hunted defector hires a pilot to help them reach a safe house on their own ship, but the honorable bounty hunter chasing them is their former mentor.

roles.description: Brilliant, deeply regretful, carrying a massive datapad.
Tired, bound by duty, strictly adheres to their own code.
A heavily shielded, anonymous docking bay in the dark zone.
A top-of-the-line pursuit vessel with overwhelming firepower.
The ruthless shadow government hunting the defector.
Automated defense drones programmed to protect the defector.

public_situation: The {role:intelligence_agency} has placed a massive bounty on the {role:hunted_defector}, claiming they stole classified weapon schematics.
private_truth: The defector actually stole evidence that the agency was testing bioweapons on civilians. The hunter doesn't know the truth yet.

beats.public_change: The hunter arrives in the system and begins locking down all outbound traffic.

missions.reason: The hunter hires the pilot to scan the dark zone relay for any encrypted transmissions matching the defector's signature.
missions.private_fact: The pilot discovers the defector hiding in a shielded cargo container.

missions.reason: The defector begs the pilot to collect a specialized jammer from a dead drop to block the hunter's sensors.
missions.private_fact: The drop is surrounded by automated proximity mines.

beats.public_change: The defector makes a run for the border, pursued closely by the hunter.

missions.reason: The defector hires the pilot to deliver a decoy data drive to a different station to throw the hunter off their scent.
missions.private_fact: The decoy works, buying the defector precious time to run.

beats.public_change: The hunter realizes the trick and corners the defector in the dark zone.

missions.reason: The hunter asks the pilot to destroy the defector's automated escort drones so the hunter can board their ship safely.
missions.private_fact: During the fight, the defector broadcasts the bioweapon evidence on open comms for the hunter to hear.

beats.public_change: The hunter is shaken by the truth but refuses to break their contract.

missions.reason: The defector begs the pilot to attack the hunter's corvette and disable its engines so they can escape.
missions.private_fact: The hunter hails the pilot, offering them the entire bounty to stand down and let the arrest happen.

resolutions.summary: The hunter is disabled. The defector escapes and leaks the bioweapon evidence to the press. The agency is thrown into chaos.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot disabled an honorable bounty hunter to help a whistleblower escape.

resolutions.summary: The hunter completes the arrest. The defector is executed by the agency, and the bioweapon research continues in secret.
The hunter destroys the defector's ship, but takes critical damage and burns up in the dark zone. The agency wins entirely.

loose_threads.detail: The hunter admits they actually raised the defector from childhood before the agency recruited them.
The bioweapon wasn't meant for an enemy faction; it was designed to wipe out the agency's own lower-class workers.

voice_direction.hunted_defector: Desperate, fast-talking, incredibly smart but terrible at lying.
voice_direction.honorable_hunter: Slow, deliberate, speaks like a disappointed parent.
